source: iphone-frames dataset: Apple Accessory Design Guidelines dimensional drawings (each model's drawing.url); values extracted automatically, then checked by a person model by model (each model's review.dimensions)

device.definition: Centre of the display active area, on the outer surface of the front cover glass. +X right edge, +Y top edge, +Z out of the screen (Core Motion device axes).

magsafe.definition: Centre of the MagSafe keep-out circle on the back, on the back-plate surface. +Z out of the back.
magsafe.source: sheet 2, Ø57.50 circle centred on the marked PRODUCT CENTER
magsafe.note: Keep-out circle centre; the drawing does not label it as the coil/magnet centre.

cam_ultra_wide_optical.definition: Centre of the lens window, on the outer surface of the camera cover glass. OpenCV optical axes of the native image: +X image right (body -Y), +Y image down (body -X), +Z the viewing direction (out of the back).
cam_ultra_wide_optical.role_basis: inferred: wider keep-out cone (131 deg, section F-F)

orientation.basis: derived from ARKit camera axes (diag(1,-1,-1)); rotation_deg 90 measured on iPhone 17 Pro

cam_main_optical.definition: Centre of the lens window, on the outer surface of the camera cover glass. OpenCV optical axes of the native image: +X image right (body -Y), +Y image down (body -X), +Z the viewing direction (out of the back).
cam_main_optical.role_basis: inferred: narrower keep-out cone (82 deg, section F-F)

orientation.basis: derived from ARKit camera axes (diag(1,-1,-1)); rotation_deg 90 measured on iPhone 17 Pro

cam_front_optical.definition: Front camera centre projected onto the outer surface of the front cover glass. OpenCV optical axes of the unmirrored native image (+X image right, +Y image down), +Z the viewing direction (out of the screen).
cam_front_optical.source: estimated, notch model: centre of the front camera + Face ID keep-out zone (pill 33.36 x 5.70, R2.85, centred u 35.76, v 5.47; sheet 2 detail E). The camera sits somewhere inside this zone; Apple does not mark it, so this origin can be off by up to ~14 mm along X.

orientation.basis: older front sensor; rotation_deg 270 from community reports (developer forums thread 106891), not measured

ultra_wide.role_basis: inferred: wider keep-out cone (131 deg, section F-F)

main.role_basis: inferred: narrower keep-out cone (82 deg, section F-F)
